current_source_review.historical_scope: The original capture date, baseline revision, and disposition receipt remain the historical K1.3 packet. Current projections include the reviewed incumbent additions without upgrading any journey, broker, or cutover evidence.
reviewed_changes: ProducerConfig and ConsumerConfig expose ordered raw properties through with_property, set_property, and extra_properties. Repeated keys replace in place; explicitly written typed mappings win, while absent optional typed fields do not erase raw values.
RebalanceStats, KafkaRebalanceProtocol, and TransientConsumerError add three public groups. KafkaRebalanceStats is a third renamed facade alias; TransientConsumerError remains module-public.

Configured cooperative callback intent and relaxed attempted-operation counters are distinct from the negotiated protocol accessor. Caller-driven rebalance remains a separate explicit assign/unassign path.

Primary poll retains UnknownTopicOrPartition diagnostics and continues to its original deadline. The accessor clones a retained entry, saturates repeated counts, and does not report broker health or clear on successful poll or close.

Raw configuration values are redacted in Debug and native ClientConfig rejection paths, including the parallel KafkaClient consumer constructor. Explicit property access and Clone retain values; property names and other upstream error variants are outside that sanitation claim.

Producer flush now awaits the Cx timer/yield path but still accounts requested slices. Consumer close and Drop use bounded leave-group draining; neither is evidence of completed cleanup after an abandoned close.
current_source_review.evidence_boundary: Current-source static review only. No new native feature, broker, migration, or release acceptance is established by this packet.

policy.current_contract_rule: Every accepted present K0.1 public row and K0.2 semantic row is PRESERVE. K0.2 explicit absences are ADDITIVE_GAP. Routed findings are REVIEWED_EVOLUTION_INPUT and do not rewrite current behavior.
policy.two_axis_rule: Contract disposition and gate state are independent. PRESERVE records the accepted current contract; BLOCKING records missing later implementation, verification, refresh, or terminal evidence.
policy.evolution_rule: A later owner may record REVIEWED_EVOLUTION only with current behavior, target behavior, migration impact, implementation owner, independent verifier, and terminal receipt. K1.3 does not project future changes backward into K0.
policy.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN usage remains identified, owned, and migration-blocking until K14.1 refresh evidence exists.
policy.profile_rule: Native no-feature builds retain the typed facade and fail closed at broker-directed operations; deterministic and parser helpers retain their exact test, test-internals, fuzz, and cfg(fuzzing) isolation.
policy.alias_rule: Facade aliases and module-public names are distinct contract surfaces; an alias cannot replace, rename, widen, or erase its module-public authority row without reviewed evolution.
